entries.meaning_example: How the hell could someone like him, who never studied during school, become a teacher?

entries.title: なぜなら
entries.meaning: because: a reason for or to do (x).
entries.meaning_example: （私は日本にいきまして、）なぜなら、三人の友達が日本にいたからです。I went to japan, because I had three friends living there.

entries.title: とは限りません, とはかぎりません
entries.meaning: it's not necessarily the case that, it does not mean that
entries.meaning_example: It's not necessarily the case that students who are studying Japanese will all be going to Japan.

entries.title: はっちゃける
entries.meaning: To party, unwind and have a good time in order to forget stresses and problems
entries.meaning_example: let's go have a good time

entries.title: ~に基づいて, ~にもとづいて
entries.meaning_example: Her theory is based on careful research

entries.title: とのこと
entries.meaning_example: According to a telephone call from Mrs. Koizumi, the arrival will be late 10 minutes.

entries.title: というのに
entries.meaning_example: 「止めなさい！」というのに、彼女は聞きません。

entries.title: 〜なかったろう
entries.meaning: Probable negative plain verbform. As in, "he probably did not go." Same meaning as -nandarou 〜なんだろう.
entries.meaning_example: 私 は 今 程 に 立派 では なかったろう、と 思い ます。(I don't think it could have been nearly as impressive as it is now.)

entries.title: 挙げ句, あげく
entries.meaning: in the end, after all, ended with bad results
entries.meaning_example: he ended up in jail
